summary: The root شَيَأ primarily means a "thing" or "something." It refers to an entity, object, or matter, whether concrete or abstract, that exists or is conceived. It can also denote a state or affair.

headwords.gloss: I incited him; made him, to do the thing; affair

parts.t: made him, to do the thing,

headwords.def: شَيَّأْتُهُ عَلَى الأَمْرِ [in some copies of the K (erroneously) شِئْتُهُ ] I incited him, or made him, to do the thing, or affair. (As, S, L, K, TA.) And شَيَّأَ ٱللّٰهُ وَجْهَهُ , (K, TA,) and خَلْقَهُ , (TA,) God rendered, or may God render, foul, unseemly, or ugly, his face, (K, TA,) and his make. (TA.)

headwords.def: أَشَآءَهُ إِلَيْهِ He, or it, compelled him, constrained him, or necessitated him, to have recourse, or betake himself, to it; syn. أَلْجَأَهُ ; (S, K;) a dial. var. of أَجَآءَهُ ; (S;) of the dial. of Temeem.
